title: Capstone Specification Builder
description: The learner composes the dryer exhaust fan specification by choosing ten attributes and writing a justification for each; every Check lists all triggered violations and advisories beside their attributes, and with zero violations the sim composes the complete fan description with the justifications.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: capstone fan specification
impeller selection
arrangement selection
drive selection
construction selection
cold start motor sizing
accessory selection
complete fan description
specification review
rights: Copyright 2026 Twin City Fan. All rights reserved.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
learningObjectives: The learner will compose a complete, internally consistent fan specification for the dryer exhaust application by choosing all ten attributes and writing a one-sentence justification for each, finishing with zero rule violations.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); check results announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✗/✓/ℹ glyphs and dashed borders pair with colour; every drop-down and justification box is labelled; the composed description is a read-only textarea that takes focus on completion.

controls.label: 1 ... 10 attribute option
controls.purpose: Choose the option for each attribute

controls.label: Show fan description / Back to attributes
controls.purpose: Switch between the form and the composed description after completion

controls.label: Copy description
controls.purpose: Copy the composed description and justifications

controls.label: Previous attributes / More attributes
controls.purpose: Move between pages when the rows do not all fit

rules: V1-V15 violation conditions from the spec, evaluated together on every Check; each blocks completion
Completion: ten attributes chosen, ten non-empty justifications, zero violations
Check presses are counted until completion
assumptions: Application values, 1,450 RPM, 96.0 BHP cold and 53.0 BHP hot are the chapter's illustrative worked example
limitations: The composed description fixes motor enclosure and power supply as in the worked example

sources: Twin City Fan Model RTF guide specification, Section 23 34 16 (tcf.com, Product Specifications in CSI format)
Chapter 12 discharge table; Chapter 9 impeller selection; Chapter 27 illustrative worked example

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Learner assembles the whole design; rule checks expose conflicts between decisions so the learner revises rather than receives the design
commonMisconceptions: The most efficient impeller is always the right one
Any arrangement works if the motor is large enough
Spark resistance of any type works at any temperature
A damper or VFD is optional when the process needs turndown
Isolators can be added without flex connectors
assessmentOpportunities: Completion with zero violations; number of checks to completion and the justifications recorded (FP.events 'answered' per check, 'completed' at completion).
